_comment: The register of source documents behind every regulatory fact in this repository. The documents themselves live in a store OUTSIDE the repository — /data/regulations on an installation, override with CARGOPILOT_REGULATIONS_DIR — because regulatory texts are not ours to redistribute and docs/data-sources.md promises they never enter the repository. What is recorded here is metadata: where a document comes from, which edition it is, and the sha256 of the exact file the facts were read from, so a future reading can prove it read the same book. Managed with scripts/regulations_store.py; architecture and update procedure in docs/regulatory-database.md.

store.note: The fallback is the cache path the CI workflows already persist with actions/cache. A document is looked up by its filename below, identical in every location.

documents.title: ADR 2025 Volume I (ECE/TRANS/352 Vol. I)
documents.role: Second reading of the land-mode provisions: exemptions, LQ/EQ, tunnels, placarding, security, documentation. Quoted to run logs by scripts/read_land_regulations.py; never committed.
documents.note: Free of charge from the publisher. The server refuses non-browser requests; the store tool knows the way round (browser headers, then the web archive).

documents.title: ADR 2025 Volume I, French (ECE/TRANS/352 Vol. I)
documents.role: French proper shipping names of column (2). ADR is authentic in English and French alike, so this is a source text and not a translation of one.
documents.note: Free of charge from the publisher, but unreachable on 2026-08-14: 403 direct at both URLs, 404 in the web archive. The French names in the seeds predate this register; retry, or check the publisher's download page for a moved address.

documents.title: ADR 2025 Volume II (ECE/TRANS/352 Vol. II)
documents.role: Second reading of table A against the Dutch reading, and the English half of the class 1 compatibility check of 7.1.4.3.4 borrowed by the ADN work.
documents.note: Free of charge from the publisher.

documents.title: RID 2025 (Appendix C to COTIF, Annex)
documents.role: The rail provisions where they differ from road: 7.5.3 protective distance, the RID points basis.
documents.note: Free of charge from the publisher.

documents.title: ADN 2025
documents.role: Second reading of the inland-waterway provisions and of the Dutch ADN readings: 1.1.3.6, 7.1.4.3, 7.1.5.0, column (8), and — still owed — table C.
documents.note: Free of charge from the publisher. Fetched 2026-08-14 via the web archive (the publisher answered 403); 19,452,780 bytes.

documents.title: ADR 2025, official Dutch edition, complete text
documents.publisher: Rijksoverheid (Dutch official edition of UNECE ADR 2025)
documents.role: First reading of the provisions implemented since v1.56.0: 5.3 placarding, 1.10.3 security, 3.2.1 column explanations, 1.1.3.6, 8.6.3. 2,102 printed pages.
documents.note: Supplied as a file; no stable public URL is recorded. If the store copy is lost, the operator's original is the way back.

documents.title: ADR 2025, official Dutch edition, table A extract
documents.publisher: Rijksoverheid (Dutch official edition of UNECE ADR 2025)
documents.role: First reading of adr_table_a.json via scripts/extract_adr_table_a.py.

documents.title: ADR 2025, official Dutch edition, alphabetical index
documents.publisher: Rijksoverheid (Dutch official edition of UNECE ADR 2025)
documents.role: The independent cross-check of the table A reading: every name looked up backwards.

documents.title: ADN 2025, official Dutch edition, HTML export indexed by section
documents.publisher: Ministerie van Defensie (visitorsweb.mindef.nl publication of ADN 2025)
documents.role: First reading of adn_table_a.json and of the ADN provisions implemented since v1.59.0: 1.1.3.6, 7.1.4.3, 7.1.5.0, 3.2.1 column (8). 2,626 sections; holds the table C pages (706 rows) still awaiting their second reading.
documents.obtained: built from the mindef.nl HTML pages, one JSON object per section number
documents.note: The source host answers only from some networks. The known damage in this edition is recorded where it was found: the 7.1.4.3.4 compatibility matrix (row N carries thirteen cells) and the 7.1.5.0.2 comparison operators.

documents.title: IMDG Code Amendment 42-24 (IMO resolution MSC.556(108))
documents.publisher: IMO, adopted 23 May 2024, in force 1 January 2026
documents.role: First reading of imdg_dgl.json, imdg_codes.json and imdg_42_24.json via scripts/extract_imdg_dgl.py and extract_imdg_codes.py.
documents.note: The IMDG Code itself is paywalled; this amendment resolution is publicly hosted. The consolidated code remains unavailable, which is why the sea seeds name the amendment as their source.
